integrity: Exact symbolic checks support the derivation but are not an independent audit; the interval theorem of Coppel is used as an established published theorem.
publication_priority: Not independently established; the closest accessible prior calculation gave cycle existence and a local multiplier, not the global theorem or unique-cycle classification.
scientific_limitations: Global convergence is for 4/25<c<=1 with the lower-cost player's initial effort strictly between zero and one, and strictly positive smooth best responses.
Results do not cover zero-opponent reset conventions, unrestricted initial efforts or three-player contests.
The uniqueness result is for positive primitive period-two orbits only; higher periods are not classified below the threshold.
No critical-rate asymptotic or uniform convergence rate is asserted.
title: A sharp global convergence boundary for asymmetric lottery-contest best responses
